sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: A prodigious woman hailed for having the most sagacious intellect in all of Lumelux. She attended a school built by the queen to enhance the quality of life for the commoners, which is where Natalia’s talents truly flourished. Profoundly admiring the queen for granting her the opportunity to learn, she sought ways to contribute to the kingdom as a civilian. However, her involvement in political affairs drew the ire of some nobles. As a result of an unjust law, she was exiled to the borderlands. Yet, it’s said that she often visited the capital in disguise, offering counsel to the people.
